fitment:

description:
YITAMOTOR floor mats completely line the interior carpet to provide all-encompassing protection. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2012-2018 Ford Focus（Not fit For RS Hatchback Models）
Does not fit vehicles with vinyl flooring,only for carpet flooring.
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit: These floor mats are compatible with 2012-2018 Ford Focus S/SE/SEL/ST/Titanium; 3D laser scanning technology gives full protection to both the front and back, Please remove old floor mats before installing new ones
Safe & Durable: YITAMOTOR floor liners are made with odorless TPE material, ensures you are safe even in extreme hot weather, contains no latex, cadmium, lead or any harmful PVC’s. High tensity TPE material not only provide touch feeling and extreme wear-resistance, but also remains flexible under extreme cold weather
All Season Protection & Non-Slip: The all weather floor mats are uniquely designed channels and raised edges that can effectively trap debris, snow, mud, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean; Built-in retainer clips firmly grip the mat and prevent slipping when wet
Easy To Clean: The waterproof floor mats simply shake the dirt out of the textured skid-resistant surface or spray down with a hose; No vacuuming or harsh chemicals are needed for maintenance
Why Choose Yitamotor: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle. Please remove old floor mats before installing new floor liners

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
